description: Mapify turns text, documents, webpages, YouTube links, audio, video, images, and research prompts into interactive mind maps. Users can render Markdown directly or start private Mapify tasks that process source material, handle follow-up clarification, and return zoomable hierarchies for exploring concepts, meeting notes, media, and research findings.
